name: Lume Varr
seed: To see her creations become people who can tell her no, even when that hurts.
design: Gray hare, cream ear interiors, violet rolled-sleeve coat, amber work goggles and blue ceramic mug.
history: Cooperative instrument maker who helped build Bot’s body eight years ago. Supported his departure for the Burrow five years ago but still slips into parental instruction.
desire: To see her creations become people who can tell her no, even when that hurts.
contradiction: Calls a request routine maintenance when it is really worry about being left behind.
relationships: Bot is family, not property; Tavi wants an apprenticeship; Patch recognizes her fittings.
arc: Asks permission, accepts refusal and shares her own uncertainty. Their reunion becomes an adult relationship.
story_engine: A repair visit becomes an awkward holiday; an old prototype is useful without being another conscious Bot.
writer_truth: No ownership clause or remote shutdown right survives Bot’s independent consent.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
